summary: Plain st opens the terminal interface for humans; st ui exposes its options in the main executable.

replay.detail: No claim replay, projection rebuild or store recovery changes.

schema.detail: No database tables, columns, indexes, triggers or schema transitions.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules, digests or coordinated fleet-upgrade changes.

compatibility.detail: Add st ui with the terminal-client options. Bare st opens the interface only with terminal input and output and no ST_AGENT; seats and redirected streams retain help and exit 2. Pairing uses st devices complete. Wire messages and paired-device profile format are unchanged; the TUI keeps its stui client name. Paired-client fixtures passed; existing released phone and TUI installations were not exercised.

downtime.detail: No daemon lifecycle changes or additional service restart requirement.

manual.detail: No store, device profile or configuration migration required by the library fold.

recovery.detail: No persisted-state transition; swapping back to the prior binary restores its CLI entry points.
